rows.output: The judge, Khalid Barnes, was charged with the murder of two drug addicts but was acquitted in September 2009.
rows.reference: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.

rows.source: Ni igba ikẹhin ti a funni ni idajọ iku nni ẹjọ Gbogboogbo New York ni 1953 fun Julius ati Ethel Rosenberg, tọkọtaya kan ti a pa lẹhin ti wọn ti fi ẹsun iyọkẹlẹ wolu fun Soviet Union nigba ogun buburu ni ọdun meji ṣaaju.
rows.output: In the last year of the death penalty in the United States, the Supreme Court of the State of New York in 1953 sentenced Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple who were executed after being convicted of espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years earlier.
rows.reference: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.

rows.source: Awọn Rosenbergs mejeeji ni wọn pa nipasẹ ijoko mọnamọna ni June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Both the Rosenbergs were executed by electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.reference: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, ọmọ abinibi ti Usibekisitani, ko ronupiwada ni awọn ọjọ ati awọn osu lẹhin ikọlu, ni ibamu si awọn iwe ile ẹjọ.
rows.output: Saipov, a native of Usbekistan, did not repent in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.reference: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.

rows.source: O sọ fun awọn oluwadi pe inu oun dun si ohun ti oun ṣe, awọn olopa jabọ.
rows.output: He told the investigators that he was happy with what he had done, the police said.
rows.reference: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.

rows.source: Saipov sọ fun awọn alase pe oun ni imisi lati ṣe ikọlu naa lẹhin wiwo awọn fidio ISIS lori foonu rẹ, gẹgẹbi ibawi naa.
rows.output: Saipov told investigators he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the complaint.
rows.reference: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.

rows.source: O tun bere lati ṣe ifihan asia ISIS ni yara iwosan rẹ, awọn olopa jabọ.
rows.output: He also began to display ISIS flags in his hospital room, police said.
rows.reference: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.

rows.source: O ti gba ẹbi pe ko jẹbi si ẹsun-aṣiṣe 22.
rows.output: He has been acquitted of the 22 counts of fraud.
rows.reference: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.

rows.source: David Patton, ọkan ninu awọn agbẹjọro awọn eniyan gbogboogbo ti o ṣoju Saipov, sọ pe wọn "ni idaniloju ijakulẹ" pẹlu ipinnu ẹjọ naa.
rows.output: David Patton, one of the lawyers for the general public who represented Saipov, said they were "disappointed" with the court's decision.
rows.reference: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.

rows.source: "A ro pe ipinnu lati wa ẹbi iku yatọsi ki eeyan gba ẹsun ijẹbi fun igbesi aye ni tubu laini ọna abayọ yoo mu ero ibanujẹ pupọ ti iṣẹlẹ yii wa fun gbogbo awọn ti o kan," Patton sọ.
rows.output: "I believe that the decision to seek the death penalty is a personal one, and that individuals should be held accountable for their actions in life, not in prison, in order to bring a sense of justice to this tragic event for all those involved," Patton said.
rows.reference: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.

rows.source: Awọn ẹgbẹ ajẹjọ ti Saipov beere tẹlẹ bẹẹbẹ lọwọ awọn agbẹjọro lati maa beere fun ijiya iku.
rows.output: The Saipov family's legal team has previously requested that the prosecution seek the death penalty.
rows.reference: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.

rows.source: Tory MP sọ wipe NIGEL FARAGE yẹ ki o wa ni iṣakoso fun awọn ijiroro Brexit

rows.output: But Ms May's challenge is to unite the divided factions of the Remain Tory party against Brexit in the city.
rows.reference: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.

rows.output: The group assured that it would continue to try to negotiate with Brussels despite the disintegration - and force Eurosceptics and the Workers' Party to choose between what they say and 'Disintegration'.

rows.source: Ọgbẹni Bone sọ fun iwọde Fisilẹ Tumọsi Fisilẹ ni Solihull pe oun fẹ lati 'Fun Awọn Alayẹwo'.
rows.output: Mr. Bone told the Fisile Tumọsi Fisile in Solihull that he wanted to 'Entertain the Inspectors'.
rows.reference: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.

rows.output: Mr. Farage should be a member and have the responsibility to negotiate with Brussels.
rows.reference: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.

rows.source: 'Ti o ba jẹ olori, a o ti jade ni bayi,' o wi pe

rows.output: The MP for Wellingborough added: 'I will stand for Brexit but we need to explore the Auditors.'
rows.reference: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'

rows.source: Ṣiṣeto atako yii si EU, o sọ bẹẹ: 'A ko ja ogun agbaye lati wa laaye.
rows.output: Setting up this attack on the EU, he said: 'We are not fighting a world war to be allowed.

rows.source: A fẹ ṣe awọn ofin ti ara wa ni orilẹ-ede wa.'
rows.output: We want to make our own laws in our own country.
rows.reference: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'

rows.source: Ọgbẹni Bone fagile imọran pe ero ti awọn eniyan ti yipada lati ọdun idibo 2016: 'Awọn idaniloju pe awọn eniyan Britani ti yi ọkàn wọn pada ati pe wọn fẹ lati duro jẹ irọ patapata.'
rows.output: Mr. Bone dismissed the notion that the public's mind had changed since the 2016 referendum: 'The assurances that the British public had changed its mind and wanted to stay in the EU were entirely spurious.'
rows.reference: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns naa wa ni iwọde, o sọ fun awọn oniroyin: 'Mo kan n sọ pe: Minisita Alakoso, fetisi awọn eniyan.
rows.output: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns is in hiding, telling reporters: 'I'm just saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.reference: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.

rows.source: 'Awọn Oluṣayẹwo jẹ alailokiki lọdọ gbogbogbo, Alatako ko ni dibo fun, ko lokiki ninu ẹgbẹ wa ati awọn ajijagbara wa ti o wa ita gbangba lati dibo fun wa.
rows.output: The Inspectors are unknown to the public, Alako is not elected, not popular in our party and our allies outside to vote for us.
rows.reference: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.

rows.source: Jọwọ fi awọn Ṣayẹwo silẹ ki o bẹrẹ si gbọ.'
rows.output: Please check the box and start listening.

rows.source: Ninu ifiranṣẹ ti o tọ si Arabinrin May, o fi kun: 'Awọn aṣoju Minisita n pa iṣẹ wọn mọ nigba ti wọn ko ba mu awọn ileri wọn ṣẹ.'
rows.output: In a message to Ms. May, she added: 'Minister's representatives are covering up their work when they do not fulfill their commitments.'
rows.reference: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'

rows.source: Ọgbẹni Farage sọ fun awọn oluwọlu pe awọn oloselu gbọdọ ‘lero ooru’ lara ti wọn ba fẹ yi ipinnu ti a ṣe ni idibo ti 2016 pada.
rows.output: Mr. Farage told the audience that politicians must "listen to the heat" of the people if they want to change the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.reference: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.

rows.source: 'Eyi jẹ nipa ọrọ ifọkantan laarin wa - awọn eniyan - ati egbe oselu wa,' o sọ.
rows.output: This is about the contract between us - the people - and our political party, he said.
rows.reference: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.

rows.source: 'Wọn n gbiyanju lati da Brexit a wa loni lati sọ fun wọn pe,' Awa ki yoo jẹ ki ẹ mu eleyi jẹ'.
rows.output: They are trying to force Brexit on us today to tell us, 'We will make this happen.
rows.reference: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'

rows.source: Ninu ifiranṣẹ kan si ero ti o ni itara ti o fi kun: 'Mo fẹ ki ẹ jẹki awọn oselu wa, ti o wa ni ipo dida Brexit, lero ooru naa.
rows.output: In a message to the passionate pro-European leader who added: 'I want you to be the politicians we have, those who are in the pro-Brexit camp, feel the heat.
rows.reference: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.

rows.source: 'A n ṣe akojọ ẹgbẹ ọmọ ogun ti orilẹ-ede yii ti o fun wa ni iṣẹgun ni Brexit ati pe ko ni si isimi titi di igba ti a ba ti di ominira, iṣakoso ara-ẹni, ounyangan iṣejọba ara ẹni United Kingdom.'
rows.output: 'We are compiling a list of the national army's personnel who have given us the victory in Brexit and who will not be silenced until we become a free, self-governing, independent United Kingdom.'
rows.reference: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'

rows.source: Nibayi, Ramainers wọ kọja Birmingham ṣaaju ki wọn to pejọ fun iwọde wakati meji ni aarin ilu naa.
rows.output: Meanwhile, Ramainers moved across Birmingham before gathering for a two-hour protest in the city center.

rows.output: These are the people who tell us that they have the IT systems in place and all the technology for Canada, for an unlimited cycle, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.reference: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.

rows.source: 'O jẹ aiṣeeṣe patapata.

rows.output: There's nothing quite like a good Brexit, he said.

rows.source: Warren, alátakò Ààrẹ Donald Trump ní gbogbo ìgbà, máa díjẹ lẹ́ẹ̀kan si pẹ̀lú Geoff Diehl , ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican àti aṣojú ìpínlẹ̀ ní oṣù kọkànlá. Diehl jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn alága ní ìlú Massachusetts fún ìpolongo Trump ní 2016.
rows.output: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is once again facing off against Geoff Diehl, a Republican state representative and former Trump campaign co-chairman in November. Diehl is one of the few elected officials in Massachusetts who supported Trump in 2016.

rows.output: One of the things that I find most interesting about the history of the world is the fact that it is constantly changing.

rows.output: On Saturday, the Baton Rogue, La., police announced the arrest of a 17-year-old suspect who fatally shot Wayde Sims, a member of the LSU basketball team.

rows.output: The police are currently investigating a shooting that occurred on Wednesday. They have identified the person who was shot but have not yet released that information.

rows.output: On Saturday, the Southern University football team's bus was shot at, killing Sims, a 20-year-old soldier.

rows.output: Superintendent Murphy J. Paul told 247Sports that "The death of Wayde Sims is a tragedy that has left our community in shock."
rows.reference: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.

rows.source: Wayde ń gbèjà ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀ ni kí Simpson tó yìnbọn fun un.

rows.output: In the interview, Simpson admitted that he was at the scene, he was the shooter, and he shot Wayde Sims.

rows.output: Simpson was arrested by the police in East Baton Rouge Parish.

rows.output: Sims, a 32-year-old rookie, threw a touchdown pass for his team in the second quarter. He led them to a score in the 10th minute.

rows.output: It is becoming increasingly clear that there is no tolerance for different views within the Labour Party and that any view that is not accepted by the party leaders is punished.

rows.source: Wannan ya fara jim kaɗan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, don abokan aiki da nake jin a da muna da irin mahangar siyasa sun fara tsammani zan yi wani juyi da daukan matsaya da ba zan taɓa yarda da su ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwa guda ta Tarayyar Turai.
rows.output: This began just a short time after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues I had previously worked with, who had a political view similar to mine, began to expect that I would take a stance on issues such as defense or the single market of the European Union that I would never agree with.

rows.output: But in reality, the message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, but to the wards, or to Labour members or not: I am proud to work for the public and I promise that no kind of threat of a re-election or political confusion will prevent me from working in what I believe is the best thing for the public good.

rows.output: In one section, it was told to the participants that preventing long-term sleep deprivation can increase the risk of heart attacks, fatigue, depression, and anxiety.
rows.reference: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.

rows.source: Wata taswirar makarantar, tare da alamomi na ma’amala, sa’an nan ƙarfafa gwiwar masu halartar don tunani game da abin da suke yi a kullum ɗinsu.
rows.output: A map of the school, with symbols of interactions, then encouraged the participants to think about what they do every day.
rows.reference: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.

rows.source: ‘Mun sani ba zai canza ɗabi’ar ɗalibai nan take ba.
rows.output: We know that it will not change the behavior of students overnight.
rows.reference: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.

rows.source: Amma mun yi imani suna da ‘yanci su sani - kawai kamar yadda kake da wani ‘yanci na sanin illoli ga lafiya na zaɓan shan sigari,’ Farfesa Czeisler ya ƙara da cewa.
rows.output: But we believe that they have the right to know - just as you have the right to know the potential health effects of smoking,' Professor Czeisler added.
rows.reference: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.

rows.source: Al’adar cika baki a cikin ‘jan dukkan dare’ har yanzu tana nan, inji shi, yana mai ƙari da cewa fasahar zamani da kuma ci gaba da matsi a kan ɗalibai yana nufin hana barci yana fara zama wata matsala mai girma.
rows.output: The tradition of cramming for exams all night is still prevalent, and, I would argue, is exacerbated by the fact that modern technology and the pressure on students to perform means that sleep deprivation is becoming a major problem.
rows.reference: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.

rows.source: Ya kamata tabbacin samun isasshen barci, wani mai kyau, ya zama wa ɗalibi ‘makami na boye’ don daƙile baƙin ciki, gajiya da tashin hankali, inji shi - ko don guje wa yin ƙiba, saboda hana barci yakan sa ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin yanayin rashin abinci, yana mai sa su koyaushe a yunwa.
rows.output: It is important to ensure that you get enough sleep, a good one, to be a weapon for the student to fight off the blues, fatigue, and stress, engine it - or to avoid gaining weight, as lack of sleep can put the brain in a state of malnutrition, making them always hungry.
rows.reference: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.

rows.source: Raymond So, wani mai shekaru 19 dan California mai karanta ilmin sinadarai da ilmin tsirrai da dabbobi na zahiri, shi ya taimaka wa Farfesa Czeisler tsara kwas ɗin, bayan ya ɗauki ɗaya daga ajizuwan shekarar da ta wuce a lokacin shekararsa ta farko a Harvard.
rows.output: Raymond So, a 19-year-old California student majoring in chemistry and biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course after taking one of his lectures during his first year at Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.

rows.source: Ya ce kwas ɗin ya buɗe masa idanuwansa da jan hankali don tura samun kwas ɗin a faɗin makarantar.
rows.output: He said that the class opened his eyes and sharpened his mind to push for the class to be spread throughout the school.
rows.reference: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.

rows.source: Yana fatan mataki na gaba, zai nemi dukkan ɗaliban sashen ƙarin karatu bayan digiri su cika irin shiri na karatun kafin su shiga makaranta mai gasar.
rows.output: He hopes the next step, will ask all the students of the extension program after graduation to complete a preparatory program for admission to a competitive university.
rows.reference: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.

rows.source: Farfesa Czeisler  ya ba shawarar cewa ya kamata ɗalibai su kula da saita wata faɗakarwa ta lokacin da za su kwanta barci, har ma da lokacin da za su farka, da kuma sanin illolin cutarwa na ‘shuɗin haske’ da ke fitowa daga fuskokin kayayyakin lantarki da haske na LED, wanda zai iya jefa tsarin lafiyarku ta tashi a barci a cikin wani yanayi, wanda zai kai ga matsalolin kasa barci.
rows.output: Professor Czeisler suggested that students should take care to set an alarm for when they go to bed, even if it is just for a short nap, and be aware of the health risks associated with 'blue light' emitted by electronic devices and LED lights, which can interfere with your body's natural sleep-wake cycle and lead to sleep disorders.
rows.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

rows.source: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard
rows.output: Livingston 1, Rangers 0: Meninga's goal silences the crowd of Gerrard.
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

rows.source: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers were punished in the second half when Dolly Menga's shot forced Steven Gerrard to concede a penalty, resulting in a score of 1-0 in favor of Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

rows.source: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.
rows.output: The Ibrox side are looking to provide their manager with his first win on the road since their 4-1 victory at St Johnstone in February, but Gary Holt's team have only lost twice in 18 games under their new manager, leaving him with eight defeats in the league.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.
rows.output: Menga scored the opening goal seven minutes before half-time and Rangers' substitute struck a low shot that was never going to be saved.
rows.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

rows.source: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.
rows.output: While Rangers are now down to sixth place, Livingston has climbed up to third place and are only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

rows.source: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.
rows.output: And there could be further tension in store for Rangers after the only linesman, Calum Spence, was injured in the 34th minute when he appeared to be struck by an object from the stands.
rows.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas zuwa ga ɓangaren wanda ya jefa Ayr cikin wasannin kafin ƙarshe na Kofin Betfred.
rows.output: Gerrard made eight changes to the side that had beaten Ayr in the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
rows.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

rows.source: Holt, a wani ɓangaren, ya tafi tare da irin Livi 11 ɗin wanda ta cire ɗigo daga Hearts mako da wuce kuma da ya yi murna da irin yadda waɗanda ya horar suka wahalar da masu adawarsu a kowane juyin da aka yi.
rows.output: Holt, on the other hand, went with the Livis 11th, who removed the dig from Hearts a week ago and were celebrating the way their trainees had made life difficult for their opponents in every turn.
rows.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

rows.source: Za a kila ce Rangers sun mamaye kame ƙwallon amma Livingston sun yi abubuwa da yawa da ƙwallon da suka samu.
rows.output: The Rangers may have been expected to dominate possession, but Livingston did a lot with the ball they had.
rows.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

rows.source: Ya kamata a ce sun ci kawai a mintina biyu na farawa lokacin musayar Menga ta farko da ta aika Scott Pittman ta cikin cin Allan McGregor amma mai tsaron tsakiya ya faɗaɗa damarsa babba sosai.
rows.output: They should have said that they only scored in the first two minutes of the first half when Menga's first exchange with Scott Pittman sent Allan McGregor through, but the goalkeeper's big save opened up a huge opportunity.
rows.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

rows.source: Wani dukan da ba tarewa na Keaghan Jacobs sai ya sami gola Craig Halkett amma abokinsa mai tsaro Alan Lithgow ya iya kawai faɗaɗawa ne a bayan matsayar.
rows.output: Keaghan Jacobs' cross was met with a powerful header from Craig Halkett, but his teammate, defender Alan Lithgow, could only clear the ball behind the goal.
rows.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

rows.source: Rangers ta dai kama sarrafa amma akwai alamar ƙarin fata maimakon yarda game da wasansu a ukun ƙarshe.
rows.output: The Rangers were in control, but there was a hint of more optimism than acceptance of their performance in the last three games.
rows.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos ba shakka ya ji ya kamata a ce ya sami wani bugu daga kai sai gola a makin kashi na uku na rabin sa’a kamar yadda shi da Steven Lawless suka yi karo amma alƙalin wasa Steven Thomson ya manta koke-koke na Colombia.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos was clearly deserving of a penalty from the third minute of injury time as he and Steven Lawless collided, but referee Steven Thomson forgot to award a penalty to Colombia.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

rows.source: Rangers ta yi ƙoƙarin kawai buge-buge na rabin farko na biyu a kan abin hari amma tsohon golan Ibrox Liam Kelly bai nuna wata damuwa ba daga bugun kai na Lassana Coulibaly da kuma wani harin sauri na Ovie Ejaria.
rows.output: Rangers tried to force the pace in the second half but old Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly showed no concern from Lassana Coulibaly's header and Ovie Ejaria's quick shot.
rows.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

rows.source: Yayin da buɗin da Livi ta samu na mintina 34 kila ya zama a kan sake wasa, ba wanda zai iya ƙi sun cancance shi don cinsu da kawai suka samu.
rows.output: While Livi's 34-minute opening may have been on the generous side, no one can deny that they deserved it just for the effort they put in.
rows.reference: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.

rows.source: Rangers sun sake kasa magance wani hoɓɓasa da Jacobs ya yi.
rows.output: Rangers again failed to address a problem that Jacobs created.
rows.reference: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.

rows.source: Scott Arfield bai yi martani ba inda Declan Gallagher ya sa ƙwallon zuwa ga Scott Robinson, wanda ya yi sanyi ga ɗaukan Menga na ɗan ƙaramin gamawa.
rows.output: Scott Arfield was unable to respond as Declan Gallagher headed the ball to Scott Robinson, who made a great run to meet Menga's low finish.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi aiki a hutun inda ya sauya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent kuma sauyi ya kusan samar da wani tasirin nan da nan a matsayin mai kai hari ta kusurwa na sakun da ka yi wa Morelos amma mai ban sha’awa Kelly ya yi gudu daga layinsa don ya toshe.
rows.output: Gerrard worked the cross where he replaced Coulibaly and Ryan Kent and the change almost had an immediate impact as a striker by heading the corner that you gave to Morelos but the exciting Kelly ran from his line to block it.
rows.reference: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.

rows.source: Amma Livingston ya ci gaba da soka maziyartan zuwa irin ainihin wasan da suke morewa, tare daLithgow da Halkett suna samun doguwar ƙwallo a sama a bayan doguwar ƙwallo.
rows.output: But Livingston continued to prod the players to the very essence of the game, with Lithgow and Halkett getting long balls in the air behind the long ball.
rows.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

rows.source: Ɓangaren Holt da sun faɗaɗa matsayinsu na gaba a cikin matakan ƙarshe amma McGregor ya tsaya sosai ya hana Jacobs kafin Lithgow ya yi bugun ka daga kwanar.
rows.output: The Holt section had extended their lead in the final stages but McGregor held his ground to deny Jacobs before Lithgow fired a late shot from the corner.
rows.reference: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.

rows.source: Mai maye gurbi na Rangers twato Glenn Middleton ya sami wani neman ƙarshe na wani fenalti a inda ya yi ta ƙoƙarin tare da Jacobs amma Thomson ya kau da kai.
rows.output: Rangers' replacement winger Glenn Middleton scored a late goal in a bid to catch up with Jacobs, but Thomson thwarted him.
rows.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

rows.source: Almanac: Wanda ya ƙago Geiger Counter
rows.output: Almanac: The Man Who Invented the Geiger Counter
rows.reference: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter

rows.source: Kuma yanzu wani shafi ne daga "Sunday Morning" Almanac ɗinmu: 30 ga Satumba, 1882, shekaru 136 a yau, ana kuma CI GABA DA KIRGE ... ranar da aka haifi masanin ilmin yanayin duniya da zai so gaba Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger a cikin Jamus.
rows.output: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, also CI GABA DA KIRGE ... the day that was born the scientist of the atmosphere that would later become Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger in Germany.
rows.reference: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.

rows.source: Geiger ya gina wata hanya don gane da auna yanayin aikin tururin, wani abin ƙiƙira daga ya kai ga na’urar da aka sani a matsayin Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Geiger built a method to detect and measure the conditions of the radioactive activity, a device that led to the creation of the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.

rows.source: Wata madogarar kimiyya ne tun wancan lokacin, Geiger Counter ta zama wata madogara a al’adar ta lokaci da ake marmari, inda a fim din 1950 "Bells of Coronado," da waɗanda ba a gani masana ne na kimiyya Roy Rogers da Dale Evans suka fito a taurari:
rows.output: A science fiction film, the Geiger Counter became a symbol of the era of nuclear anxiety, as seen in the 1950 film "Bells of Coronado," starring the science fiction heroes Roy Rogers and Dale Evans.
rows.reference: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:

rows.source: Mutum: "Mene ne a cikin duniyar nan shi ɗin?"
rows.output: Person: "What is in this world that is mine?"

rows.source: Rogers: "Shi ne Geiger Counter, da ake amfani wajen gano albarkatun ƙasa, irin su sinadaran uranium.
rows.output: Rogers: "That's the Geiger Counter, used for detecting radioactive materials, such as uranium.
rows.reference: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.

rows.source: A yayin da ka sa waɗannan na’urorin kunne, za ka iya ainihin jin halayen aiwatar na sinadaran atom da aikin tururin ke samarwa a cikin albarkatun.”
rows.output: When you put these headphones on, you can literally hear the characteristics of the atomic substances and the action of the evaporation process that produce resources.

rows.source: Evans: "Ka ce, da tabbaci yana fitowa yanzu!"
rows.output: Evans: "You said, it's coming out now!"

rows.output: Hans Geiger died in 1945, just a few weeks before his 63rd birthday and the end of World War II.
rows.reference: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.

rows.source: Amma abin da ya ƙago da ke amfani da sunansa yanan nan a raye.

rows.output: The new vaccine will be able to train the immune system to recognize and kill problem cells.

rows.output: The injection will train the body's immune system to recognize and target abnormal cells as part of the body's defense mechanism.
rows.reference: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment

rows.source: Hanyoyin sun haɗa da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jikin daga wani marar lafiya, jirkita su a cikin ɗakin gwajin kimiyya
rows.output: Methods include growing protective skin cells from a patient, culturing them in a laboratory dish

rows.source: Za su iya sa’an nan ‘ganin’ wani sinadarin abinci mai gina jiki da yawancin sankarori suka sani kuma sa’an nan su sake shigarwa
rows.output: They can then 'see' a nutrient that most of the body's cells recognize and then reabsorb

rows.source: Wata allurar gwaji tana nuna sakamako mai kyau a jikin marassa lafiya da ke wani ranji na sankarorin.
rows.output: A clinical trial is showing positive results in the bodies of patients who are at a certain stage of the disease.
rows.reference: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.

rows.source: Mata ɗaya da aka yi wa jinya da allurar, da ke koyar da tsarin kariyar jikin don gano sel-sel masu matsalar, ta ga sankararta ta mahaifa ta bace na fiye da watanni 18.
rows.output: A woman who was treated with the injection, and who was training in the body's immune system recognition of abnormal cells, saw her mother's tumor disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.reference: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.

rows.source: Hanyar ta hada ne da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jiki daga wani marar lafiya, inda ake gyara su a cikin dakin gwajin kimiyya yadda za su iya “ganin” wani sinadarin protein mai gina jiki da sankarori masu yawa suka sani da ake kira HER2, inda kuma ake sake shigar da su sel-sel din.
rows.output: The method involves growing immune cells from a patient's blood, where they are modified in a laboratory to be able to "see" a protein called HER2, which is known to be overexpressed in many types of cancer, and then reintroducing the modified cells into the patient.
rows.reference: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.

rows.source: Farfesa Jay Berzofsky, na Cibiyar Sankara ta Amurka da ke Bethesda, Maryland, ya ce: “Sakamakonmu yana nuna cewa da wata allura da za ta amfanar."
rows.output: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the American Cancer Society's Cancer Control Program in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our findings suggest that there is a needle that will benefit everyone."
rows.reference: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."

rows.source: Farfesa Berzofsky ya yi cewa HERS takan "janyo girman sankarori iri-iri da yawa," da suka haɗa da nono, mahaifa, huhu da ƙaba.
rows.output: Professor Berzofsky said that HERS would "bring together a wide range of different types of organs," including breasts, wombs, lungs, and intestines.
rows.reference: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

rows.source: An yi amfani da irin hanyar ta ɗaukan sel-sel da jikin marassa lafiya da "koyar" da su yadda za su kai hari ga sel-sel na sankara kuma ya yi aiki a wajen jinyar irin cutar fara.
rows.output: This approach has been used to take over the cells of the patients' bodies and "teach" them how to attack the cancer cells and work outside the body's normal immune system.
rows.reference: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.

rows.output: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town, where he wore a Make America Great hat, he passed out while in a state of delirium, supporting the Democrats and emphasizing his support for Trump.

rows.source: "A lokuta da dama na yi magana da wani farin mutum kuma sun ce: "Yaya za a yi kake son Trump, yana da aƙidar bambancin jinsi?"
rows.output: "In many cases, I have talked to a white person and they said: 'How can you want Trump, he has a gender equality theory?'"

rows.source: To, idan da na damu game da bambancin jinsi da na fice daga Amurka tun tuni," inji shi.

rows.reference: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga tayi ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya faɗi akan gwiwan shi bayan hakan kuma ya ce mata “kashi 99” “mutumin kirki” wanda ke samun akasi daga “kashi ɗaya”.
rows.output: Mayorga claimed that Ronaldo fell on his knee after that and told her "99 percent" "a good man" who gets "one percent" from "99 percent."
rows.reference: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."

rows.source: Takardur su na ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya gasganta cewa su biu sun yi jima’i, amma cikin yarjejeniya ce.
rows.output: They claim in their documents that Ronaldo was surprised that they were having an affair, but it was consensual.
rows.reference: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.

rows.source: Mayorga kuma tayi ikirari cewa ta je wajen ‘yan sanda kuma an ɗauki hotunan raunin da ta ji a asibit, amma daga baya ta yadda da sulhu a wajen kotu saboda ta ji “tsoron ramuwa” kuma ta damu akan “dizguwa a fuskar mutane.”
rows.output: Mayorga also claimed that she went to the police station and took pictures of the injuries she sustained in the hospital, but later withdrew the case in court because she was "afraid of being discredited" and worried about "discredit in the eyes of the public."

rows.output: A 34-year-old woman is now seeking to settle her debts while continuing to face consequences from her past.

rows.source: Brexit: UK ‘har abada zata yi da na sanin’ rasa masu kera motoci
rows.output: Brexit: UK 'har abada zata yi da na sanin' rasa masu kera motoci
rows.reference: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers

rows.source: UK “zata yi da na sanin shi har abada” idan tayi rashin matsayin ta na shugabancin kera mota bayan Brexit, Sakataren Sana’a Greg Clark yace.
rows.output: The UK "will be forever known as the country that lost its car manufacturing industry after Brexit," said Trade Secretary Greg Clark.
rows.reference: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.

rows.source: Ya kara cewa abun “damuwa ne” cewa Toyota UK ta fada wa BBC cewa idan Britain ta fita EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba zata sayar da aiki na dan wani lokaci a masana’antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.
rows.output: He added that it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal, it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.reference: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.

rows.source: “Mu na bukatar yarjejeniya,” Mr Clark ya ce.
rows.output: "We need an agreement," Mr. Clark said.
rows.reference: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.

rows.source: Kamfanin Japan din na mota yace tasirin jinkiri a iyakar kasa a yanayin Brexit babu yarjejeniya zai iya kwao rasa ayyuka.
rows.output: The Japanese automaker said that the impact of a hard Brexit without a deal could lead to the loss of thousands of jobs.
rows.reference: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.

rows.source: Masana’antar Burnaston din - wanda ke hada Toyota Auris da Avensis - sun kera kusan motoci 150,000 bara wanda a ciki kashi 90 aka fitar zuwa sauran kasashen Turai.
rows.output: The Burnaston plant, which manufactures the Toyota Auris and Avensis, produced around 150,000 vehicles last year, with 90 percent of those exports going to other European countries.
rows.reference: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.

rows.source: “A gani na shi ne idan Britain ta fita EU a karshen Maris zamu ga sayawar kira a masana;antar mu,” inji Mavin Cooke, Manajin Direkta na Toyota a Burnaston.
rows.output: "I can see that if Britain leaves the EU in March we will have a call for a change in our manufacturing strategy," said Marvin Cooke, director of manufacturing at Toyota in Burnaston.
rows.reference: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.

rows.source: Wasu masu kera motocin UK sun nuna jin tsoro akan fita EU ba tare da yarjejniya ba akan yadda kasuwancin tsallaken iyaka zai kasance, har da Honda, BMW da Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Some UK car manufacturers have expressed concern about the UK's exit from the EU without a deal on how trade across borders will work, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, kamar misali, ta ce zata kulle karamin masana’antar ta da ke Oxford na tsawon wata daya bayan Brexit.
rows.output: BMW, for example, has said it will close its small engine plant in Oxford for a month after Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.

rows.source: Babban damuwan yana dangance da abun da makera motoci suka ce ne dangane da hadarin samun kayayyakin aiki idan akayi Brexit ba yarjejeniya.
rows.output: The main concerns are related to the statements made by the car manufacturers regarding the risk of having production facilities if there is a Brexit deal.
rows.reference: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.

rows.source: Ana aiwatar da hanyar sarrafawar Toyota na akan tsarin “gab-da-lokaci”, yadda sassa su na isowa ko wani minti 37 daga masu kaya duk daga UK da EU na motocin da ake kira dan sari.
rows.output: The Toyota production system is based on the "just-in-time" principle, where parts arrive at the assembly line every 37 minutes from suppliers in the UK and EU of the so-called "just-in-time" principle.
rows.reference: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.

rows.source: Idan UK ta bar EU ba tare dayarjejeniya ba ranar 29 ga watan Maris, za’a iya samun matsaloli a iyaka wanda masana’antar ta ce yakan iya kawo jinkiri da rashin isashen sassa.
rows.output: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be problems at the border that the industry says would lead to delays and shortages.
rows.reference: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.

rows.source: Ba zai yiyu Toyota ta rike fiye da kayan aiki na kwana daya a masana’antar ta na Derbyshire, kamfanin ta ce, dan haka aiki zai saya.

rows.source: Mr Clark ya ce tsarin binciken Theresa May na dagantakan gaba da EU an “asalin tsara shi dan kauyce wa wadannan binciken a iyaka.”
rows.output: Mr. Clark said that Theresa May's investigation framework for future relations with the EU was "originally designed to avoid these investigations at the margins."
rows.reference: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."

rows.source: “Mu na bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Mu na so mu samu mafi kyakkyawan yarjejeniya da zai bamu daman kamar yadda na fada ba kawai nasaran da zamu ji dadin shi a halin yanzu ba amma mu samu yin amfani da wannan daman,” ya fada a tsarin Yau na Radiyon BBC 4.
rows.output: “We need to get a deal. We want to get the best possible deal that will allow us to benefit as much as I said, not just the success that we will enjoy now, but to be able to use this opportunity.” he said in the BBC Radio 4 Today program.

rows.source: 2004: Babban girgizar kasa a yammacin tekun Aceh dake arewacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga Disamban bara ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shafi kasashe 14, inda ya kashe mutane 226,000 a bakin tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin su a Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: A major earthquake in western Aceh, Indonesia, on December 26, 2004, triggered a tsunami that affected 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along the coast of Indonesia, with more than half of the deaths occurring in Aceh.

rows.source: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi amfani da motoci mai hawa na gida domin gudanar da hare-haren kan hanyar machine da ta hanyar West Side Highway a Lower Manhattan, inda ya kaddamar akan masu tafiya a kafa da kekuna a hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.

rows.source: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su tabbatar da cewa Saipov "da gangan" ya kashe mutane takwas da "ganganci" ya jawo mummunan rauni a jiki, bisa ga sanarwar na neman hukuncin kisa, aka a yankin Kudancin Sabon Gundumar New York.
rows.output: To ensure the death penalty, the prosecution will prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed eight people and "recklessly" caused serious physical injury to others, according to the notice of the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.reference: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.

rows.source: Dukkan waɗanda nan la'akari su na da hukuncin kisa, bisa ga takardun kotu.
rows.output: All those who are under consideration for the death penalty, according to court documents.

rows.source: Makonni bayan harin, babban kotun tarayya ta maka wa Saipov zarge-zarge 22 da suka hada da laifuffuka guda takwas na kisan kai don taimakon rashin gaskiya, yawanci sune masu gabatar da kara ke yi a laifukan shiryeyyen laifi, da kuma cajin tashin hankali da halakar da motoci.
rows.output: A few weeks after the attack, the federal court indicted Saipov on 22 counts, including eight counts of terrorism for providing material support to a terrorist organization, typically brought by prosecutors in terrorism cases, and for destruction of vehicles.
rows.reference: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.

rows.source: Wannan harin ya bukaci "tsarawa mai mahimmanci da kaddamarwa," in ji masu gabatar da kara, inda ya bayyana irin yadda Saipov ya dauki shi a matsayin "mai mugunta, mummunan hali da kuma marar sa tausayi."
rows.output: This attack required "significant planning and preparation," the prosecutors said, describing how Saipov took it as "a depraved, evil act and a cowardly act."
rows.reference: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwa na niyyar jihohi.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," in ji wani sanarwa na hukumar.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.

rows.output: The end of the era when the federal death penalty was imposed in New York in 1953 on Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple, after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War, two years prior.

rows.output: He pleaded not guilty to charges 22 of accusations.

rows.source: "Mu na tsammanin shawarar da za a nemi hukuncin kisa maimakon karɓar laifin mai laifi zuwa rai a kurkuku ba tare da yiwuwar saki ba zai shawo kan matsalolin abubuwan da ke faruwa ga kowa da kowa", inji Patton.
rows.output: "We believe that the decision to seek the death penalty instead of accepting a life sentence without the possibility of parole will not address the problems that are occurring for everyone," Patton said.
rows.reference: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.

rows.output: This began as soon as Jeremy became leader, my colleagues, with whom I had shared a common understanding of the political situation, started to look at me as if I would turn around immediately and take positions that I would not agree with under any circumstances - either on national defense or on the EU market.

rows.output: Since I joined the Labour Party 32 years ago as a student, inspired by the Thatcher government's gaze, which left my school in ruins, I initially wanted to lead a great public service for those who need it most - as a local council leader or government minister.
rows.reference: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.

I have not lost my appetite to waste time and energy in supporting my leaders in the Labour Party.

rows.output: But in truth one message I have is not for Nottingham Momentum, it is for my builders, or for the Labour Party, but they are not: I am pleased to serve you and I promise that no threat of expulsion or suspension will stop me from doing what I believe is best for all of you.
rows.reference: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.

rows.source: Ụlọ akwụkwọ nnwere onwe nke Scotland dowere ndekọ nzọụkwụ nke agụmakwụkwọ kachasị, ma nke a gara n’ihu na 2018 site na iji nsonaazụ ule ndị mara oke mma, nke a na agụzogide site na mmeri ndị mmadụ na ndị otu n’egwuregwu, nka, egwu na mbọ ogbe ndị ọzọ.
rows.output: The Scottish Free Church established a record of the most progressive education, but this was surpassed in 2018 by the use of more rigorous examination results, which were resisted by the victories of individuals and teams in sports, arts, music, and other forms of human endeavor.
rows.reference: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.

rows.source: Na mgbago ọnụọgụ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 30,000 n’ofe Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị a, nke The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS) na anọchite, na agba mbọ iwete ọkwa ọrụ kachasị maka ụmụ akwụkwọ ha na ndị nne na nna ha.
rows.output: With a student population of 30,000 across Scotland, these schools, represented by the Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to provide the best possible education for their students and their parents.
rows.reference: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.

rows.source: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe na agba mbọ ịkwadobe ụmụ akwụkwọ maka agụmakwụkwọ ọdịnihu na nke dị elu, ọrụaka ha họpụtara yana ọnọdụ ha ka ndị amaala ụwa.
rows.output: Independent schools strive to prepare students for higher education and future employment, and they are chosen and placed by the students themselves as global citizens.
rows.reference: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.

rows.source: Dị ka ngalaba agụmakwụkwọ nwere ike izube ma tinye usoro ọmụmụ nke ụlọ akwụkwọ dị elu, anyị na ahụ asụsụ ọhụụ ka ọ na aga n’ihu ka nke na akpọtụ yana isiokwu nke nhọrọ achọrọ n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ.
rows.output: As the education sector can plan and implement a curriculum of higher education institutions, we are also aware of the new language as it goes forward as a pull and a subject of choice in schools.
rows.reference: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.

rows.reference: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.

rows.output: If you speak to her in her own language, that will go to her heart.

rows.output: This is a great reminder that we can't rely on English when we want to build relationships and trust with people from other communities.

rows.output: The combination of 68 percent of students who studied a foreign language received an A grade.

rows.output: Data collected from 74 schools participating in SCIS showed that 72% of students received an A grade in Mandarin, while 72% of German learners, 69% of French learners, and 63% of Spanish learners received an A.

rows.output: This shows that independent schools in Scotland support foreign languages as an essential skill that children and young people will need in the future.

rows.source: Asụsụ ugbu a, dị ka nhọrọ isiokwu, ka a na ahụta n’otu anya ka isiokwu ndị STEM (sayensị, teknụzụ, ịnjinịarịn na mgbakọ na mwepu) n’usoro ọmụmụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe yana n’ebe ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: Ọkammụta Czeisler kwadoro ka ụmụ akwụkwọ chee banyere itinye otimkpu maka mgbe ha chọrọ ịrahụ ụra, yana mgbe ha chọrọ ikuli, ma marakwa maka nsonazụ mmerụ ahụ ihuenyo ngwa eletrọnịk “ihie agba elu igwe” na-ebute yana ihie LED, nke nwere ike kụpụ usoro ka ahụ gị si akpa agwa, we bute nsogbu ịrahụ ụra.
rows.output: Professor Czeisler recommended that students consider setting an alarm for when they wanted to get up, and when they wanted to go to bed, and be aware of the negative consequences of the "blue light" screen of electronic devices on their sleep cycle, which could disrupt their body's natural rhythm and lead to sleep problems.
rows.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

rows.source: Akụkụ Ibrox ahụ na-achọ inweta mmeri nke izizi ha n’ụzọ kemgbe ha meriri 4-1 na Febuarị na St Johnstone, mana ndị otu Gary Holt nyere Gerrard mmeri nke abụọ emeriri ha n’egwuregwu 18 dịka onye njikwa jiri akara asatọ esegharị n’elu nke ndị mbu na Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts.
rows.output: The Ibrox side is looking to secure their first win since their 4-1 victory over St Johnstone in February, but the team managed by Gary Holt have given Gerrard his second win in 18 games as manager with an eight-point lead over the first-place team in the Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Nyocha Johnny English Strikes Again - buturu ihe nkiri nzuzo ịkpa ọchị Rowan Atkinson
rows.output: Johnny English Strikes Again - a slapstick comedy film by Rowan Atkinson
rows.reference: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof

rows.source: Ọ bụ omenala ugbu a ịchọ mkpa Brexit n’ihe nkiri ọhụrụ ọ bụla nwere nribama Britain, na nke a dịka ọ metụtara mmegharị ihe nkiri ịkpa ọchị nke Johnny English - bụ nke ejiri Johnny English malite na 2003, wee laghachikwa azụ na 2011 ka Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: It is now a tradition to seek a Brexit angle in every new film with a British cast, and this one is no exception - as it relates to the Johnny English comedy franchise, which was first introduced with Johnny English in 2003, and then returned in 2011 as Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.

rows.source: Ọ pụtara na ihe nkiri njakịrị nke isiokwu otu anyị siri bụrụ ndị iberibe pụtara ihie, bụzi oghere nbufe ahịa ọhụrụ anyị?
rows.output: It appears that the theme of our being divided into factions is a joke, is it a new business opportunity for us?
rows.reference: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?

rows.source: Kosiladị, onye nzuzu anya ọkpụ, ihu rọba Johnny English emegharịala ikike ya ịkwalite ihe nke ugboro abụọ - aha ya karịa ihe ọ bụla na-egosi na ọ bụ nchepụta ihe ịkpa ọchị emebere maka akụkụ obodo ndị anaghị asụ Bekee.
rows.output: However, the blind man, Johnny English's plastic face, has once again failed to improve his performance - his name more than anything else shows that it is a comedy creation made for the non-English speaking parts of the city.
rows.reference: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.

rows.source: N’ezie ọ bụ onye iberibe ọrụ nzuzo nke agbanyeghị ṅṅomi ya gbagwojuru anya, nwere obere Clouseau, ntakịrị Mr Bean na nfechalụ nke nwoke ahụ n’etinye otu olu na isiokwu Chariots of Fire na mmalite mmemme Olympics London 2012.
rows.output: Of course, you're a work of art, but your work is so convoluted, with a little Clouseau, a little Mr. Bean, and the man's obsession with putting one voice on the theme of Chariots of Fire at the beginning of the London 2012 Olympic ceremony.
rows.reference: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.

rows.source: N’izizi ọ dabere n’onye njem yana nwoke nzuzo mba ụwa Atkinson nke emere na ihe mgbasa ozi Barclaycard TV echefugoro, na-ahapu ọgbaghara n’azụ ya.
rows.output: Initially, you were based on a travel agent and a global man of mystery, Atkinson, who was featured in a TV advertising campaign for Barclaycard, leaving a trail of chaos in his wake.
rows.reference: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.

rows.source: Enwere otu oge ma ọ bụ abụọ mara mma na JE ọhụrụ a.
rows.output: There is one or two beautiful moments in this new J.E.
rows.reference: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.

rows.source: Ọ masịrị m ka Johnny English na-erute nso n’ụgbọ elu ebe oyi uwe agha ndị agba ochie, igwe nkucha were na-akụta n’okpu agha ya.
rows.output: I liked Johnny English's approach to the plane, where he was wearing a cold-weather military uniform, and a machine gun was attached to his head.
rows.reference: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.

rows.source: Onyinye Atkinson nwere maka ịkpa ọchị a na-ahụ anya pụtara ihie, mana ịkpa ọchị ahụ esighi ike ma mafee oke, tụmadị ihe nkiri ndị ahụ “anaghị akpa ọchị” dịka 007 na Mission Impossible n’onwe ha na-enwekwa ihe ịkpa ọchị n’ime ya ugbu a.
rows.output: Atkinson's gift for slapstick is undeniable, but the slapstick itself is neither subtle nor over-the-top, while the films "are not funny" on their own and now have a sense of humor in them.
rows.reference: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.

rows.source: Ihe ịkpa ọchị ahụ dịka ọ bụ ụmụaka ka emebere ya karịa ndị okenye, maka mụ onwe m njegheri Johnny English enweghị ihe nchepụta pụrụ iche yana ebumnuche ya dịka ihe nkiri anaghị ekwu okwu nke Atkinson, n’onye nke Bean.
rows.output: The humor in the film was more for children than for adults, as I myself found Johnny English to be lacking in originality and with a purpose as a non-verbal film, unlike Bean's.
rows.reference: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.

rows.source: Ebe mgbado ukwu isiokwu ugbu a bụ na Great Britain nọ n’oke nsogbu.
rows.output: The current issue with the high price of oil is that Great Britain is in a great deal of trouble.
rows.reference: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.

rows.source: Onye nbanye ịntanetị anataghị ikike banyere na netwọk ndị ọrụ nzuzo kachasị dị nzuzo nke Britain, kpughee ndị ọrụ nzuzo niile nọ n’ọrụ, na mgbagwoju anya onye ọrụ nzuzo nọ ọrụ - obere ihe omume maka Kelvin Eldon.
rows.output: An unauthorized internet user infiltrated the most secret network of British intelligence operatives, revealing all operatives on duty, and confusing the identity of the operative on duty - a small feat for Kelvin Eldon.
rows.reference: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.

rows.source: Ọ bụ nke ikpeazụ maka onye isi ala bụ onye mpako nwere nsogbu, nke enweghịzi nkwado ọchịchị ọ bụla kpamkpam: Emma Thompson nwara ike ya na ime ihe omume a yitebere Teresa-May mana enwekebeghị ihe dị n’akwụkwọ ọ ga-eji rụọ ọrụ.
rows.output: It was the last for the prime minister, a man of arrogance, who had no political support at all: Emma Thompson tried her best with the task that was prepared for Theresa-May but there was nothing in the script that she could work with.
rows.reference: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.

rows.source: Ndị na-enye ya ndụmọdụ nchekwa gwara ya na ebe amagoro ndị ọrụ nzuzo ya niile, ọ ga-akpọpụta onye lagoro ezumike nka.
rows.output: The security advisers told her that since all of her employees had been kidnapped, she would have to hire a new employee.
rows.reference: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.

rows.source: Nke ahụ pụtara Johnny English na-emegheri emegheri n’onwe ya, onye nke ewere n’ọrụ dịka onye nkuzi n’ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị ọgaranya, mana na-enye nkuzi nke adịghị n’akwụkwọ ka-esi a bụ onye ọrụ nzuzo: ọmalịcha odide ebe a, dịka English nyere ụdị ụlọ akwụkwọ nzuzo School of Rock.
rows.output: That means Johnny English is self-deprecating, a man who took on the role of a teacher at an elite school, but gives lessons that are not in the syllabus as a secret agent: a bit of a mess here, as English provided a kind of secret school School of Rock.
rows.reference: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.

rows.source: Ebughachiri English na Whitehall maka inye ntuziaka ntụmadị were zukọta yana onye nke abụọ ya tagbugoro onwe ya n’ahụhụ Bough, bụ Ben Miller mere ya ọzọ.
rows.output: The English returned to Whitehall to give instructions on how to assemble and fire the second cannon, which Ben Miller had previously used to shoot Bough.
rows.reference: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.

rows.source: Bough abụrụla onye lụrụ nwunye, ejikọrọ ya na onye isi ngwa ọgụ mmiri, bụ ihe omume onye nwere agba Vicki Pepperdine mere ka onye mmanya na-egbu.
rows.output: Bough has been married, connected to the head of the naval combat, a role played by the actress Vicki Pepperdine, who is a barman.
rows.reference: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.

rows.source: Yabụ na Batman na Robin nke na emebi ihe mgbe niile N’ọrụ Nzuzo Her Majesty amalitekwala, na-ezute Olga Kurylenko dịka ọmalicha Ophelia Bulletova.
rows.output: So Batman and Robin, who always get into trouble, have started working for Her Majesty's Secret Service, meeting Olga Kurylenko as the undercover Ophelia Bulletova.
rows.reference: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.

rows.source: Kosiladị, onye isi ala na-adanye na anwansi nke onye ọgaranya tech, bụ onye nke kwuru na ọ nwere ike idozi nsogbu kọmputa ndị Britain nwere: onye ọjọọ Jason Volta bụ Jake Lacy mere ya.
rows.output: However, the president is skeptical of the tech millionaire's magic, who claimed he could solve Britain's computer problems: the evil Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.
rows.reference: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.

rows.source: English na Bough malitere njem nke egwuregwu nzuzu ịkpa ọchị ha: gbanwee dịka onye na-eke nri, ha mụnyere ọkụ n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ French; ha butere ọgbaghara izunye onwe ha n’ime ụgbọ mmiri ezumike Volta; English kpalitere mgbagwoju anya ka ọ nwara iji ngwa isi Virtual Reality nwere mata ime ụlọ Volta.
rows.output: English and Bough embarked on a journey of their absurd comedic games: they transformed as chefs, they lit a fire in a French restaurant; they caused a stir by bringing a boatload of themselves to the Volta Lake; English sparked confusion while trying to use a Virtual Reality head set with a Volta Lake view.
rows.reference: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.

rows.source: Eji ihe niile were mee agba nke ikpeazụ ahụ, ma obi uto na egwumegwu niile dị ya, enwere obere TV ụmụaka dị n’ihe niile ahụ.
rows.output: He took all the materials to make the last batch, and he had all the joy and excitement, and there was a small children's TV set in all the materials.
rows.reference: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.

rows.source: Ọmalịcha ihe agafeghị oke.
rows.output: The world is not enough.
rows.reference: Pretty moderate stuff.

rows.source: Dịka n’ihe nkiri Johnny English ndị ọzọ, ọ naghaghị m ịche: ndị na-eme ihe nkiri nke Britain enweghi ike nye Rowan Atkinson ihe omume ga-ebuputa onyinye ya nke ọma?
rows.output: Like in Johnny English and other British comedies, he can't help but be funny: the British actors just can't give Rowan Atkinson enough to work with.
rows.reference: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?

rows.source: Labour na-agọnarị na ha anaghị akpa nkata atụmatụ ka ndị Britain na-arụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu ma nara ụgwọ ọrụ maka ụbọchị ise
rows.output: The Labour Party denies that they are negotiating to have the British work four days a week and receive pay for five days.
rows.reference: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days

rows.source: Labour Party nke Jeremy Corbyn na-atule atụmatụ ga-agbanwe ihe nke ga-ahụ na ndị Britain rụọ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu ha anara ụgwọ ọrụ maka ụbọchị ise.
rows.output: The Labour Party, led by Jeremy Corbyn, is proposing a plan that would change the way people in Britain work, by giving them four days of work for five days of pay.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.

rows.source: Ndị otu a chọrọ ka ndị isi nwe ụlọ ọrụ na-enyefe akụ ha chekwabara n’aka ndị ọrụ siterena mgbanwe artificial intelligence (AI) site na inye ha ụbọchị ụma agaghị arụ ọrụ.
rows.output: This group wants corporate leaders to transfer their accumulated wealth to the workers who will be replaced by artificial intelligence (AI) systems by giving them a day of work that will not be done.
rows.reference: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.

rows.source: Ọ ga-eme na ndị na-arụ ọrụ ga-erite elele ụbọchị atọ n’izu ụka ma welakwaa otu ụgwọ ọnwa.
rows.output: He will make those who work six days a week receive a three-day holiday and double their wages.
rows.reference: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.

rows.source: Ndị nzuputa okwu kwuru na echiche a “ga-adaba” na ebumnuche yana atụmatụ akụnụba nke otu a ime ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ.
rows.output: The whistleblowers said that this "would sink" the purpose and the economic plan of the group to make the workers sink.
rows.reference: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.

rows.source: Ndị otu Trades Union Congress akwadola ịmalite ụbọchị anọ n’ime izu dịka ụzọ ndị ọrụ ga-esi rite elele na akụnụba na-agbanwe.
rows.output: The Trade Union Congress has supported the initiation of a four-day workweek as a means for workers to gain control over their time and economy.
rows.reference: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.

rows.source: Onye senịọ nzuputa okwu nke Labour Party gwara Sunday Times: ‘A na-atu anya ịma ọkwa nyocha amụma tupu ngwucha afọ a.
rows.output: The Labour Party's chief spokesperson told the Sunday Times: 'We expect to announce the results of the policy review before the end of the year.
rows.reference: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.

rows.source: ‘Ọ gaghị eme ozugbo mana ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu bụ ebumnobi ndị otu a dabara n’usoro ihazi akụnụba ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ yana mkpokota ụzọ nrụpụta ihe nke ndị otu ahụ.’
rows.output: 'It won't be immediate, but working four days a week is the goal of this team to align the economy with the workforce and the overall production capacity of the team.'
rows.reference: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'

rows.source: Labour Party agaghị abụ ndị izizi kwadoro echiche a, ebe Green Party kwere nkwa ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu n’ime oge ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị 2017.
rows.output: The Labour Party will not be the first to support this idea, while the Green Party promised to work four days a week during the 2017 election campaign.
rows.reference: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.

rows.source: Labour Party anaghị akwado ebumnuche ahụ ugbu a dịka otu, kosiladị.
rows.output: The Labour Party does not currently support the goal as a party, even though.
rows.reference: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.

rows.source: Onye nkwuchite okwu Labour Party kwuru: ‘Ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu abughị amụma ndị otu a nke na ndị otu a anaghị atule ya.’
rows.output: The Labour Party spokesperson said: 'Four-day workweek is not a policy of this party, which means that this party does not support it.'
rows.reference: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell jiri ọgbakọ Labour mere izu gara aga were kọwapụta echiche ya maka mgbanwe na akụnụba.
rows.output: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used the Labour Party conference last week to outline his ideas for a change in the economy.
rows.reference: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.

rows.source: Mazị McDonnell kwuru na o kpebiri iweghachite ikike site na n’aka ndị ‘isi ụlọ ọrụ amaghị’ yana “ndị nrite oke uru’ n’ụlọ ọrụ ndị eji ebi ndụ.
rows.output: Mr. McDonnell said he decided to take back the power from "unknown" executives and "highly paid" employees in state-owned enterprises.
rows.reference: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.

rows.source: Atụmatụ shadow chancellor ahụ pụtakwara na ndị nwere oke n’ụlọ ọrụ mmiri nwere ike ha agaghị enwetacha isi ego ha, maka gọọmentị Labour nwere ike ‘ime mwepu’ na ndabere ebumnobi ihe ezighi ezi.
rows.output: The shadow chancellor's plans were revealed to show that those with large water companies would not get their full dividends, as the Labour government could 'make cuts' in the target income of the wrong people.
rows.reference: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.

rows.source: O kwuputakwara atụmatụ itinye ndị ọrụ na bọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ma mepụta Inclusive Ownership Fund ga-enyefe pesenti 10 n’oke ụlọ ọrụ ndị nkịtị n’aka ndị ọrụ, ndị nwere ike inweta uru isi ego ruru £500.
rows.output: He also announced plans to bring workers onto the boards of companies and create an Inclusive Ownership Fund that would transfer 10 percent of the shares of publicly traded companies to workers, who could receive up to £500 in value.
rows.reference: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy gwa “60 minutes” ma nyocha ndị FBI enwere ike ịgbanwe obi ha
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 minutes" that the FBI investigation may have changed their minds
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
